scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:build && npm run build && electron electron-dist/main.js
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:build && npx electron-builder --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run electron:build && npx electron-builder --win zip --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run electron:build && npx electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.yml
